## GetTeamCosts

`POST /spin.v1.TeamService/GetTeamCosts`

What the team's workspaces cost in the month in progress, each and summed, for the team's admins: a member reads their own workspace's (WorkspaceService.GetWorkspaceCost) and nobody else's. A workspace is the team's whose it was on the last day it cost anything; a team below this one is not counted in it.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `teamId` | string |  |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `month` | `Timestamp` | The month in progress: its first instant, UTC. |
| `readAt` | `Timestamp` | When the bill was last read; unset where it never was - an installation with no bill scope - and then nothing below is known and nothing is to be drawn. |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217; every amount here is in millionths of it. |
| `total` | [CostShare](/reference/api/types/#costshare) | Its workspaces, summed. |
| `workspaces` | list of [TeamWorkspaceCost](/reference/api/types/#teamworkspacecost) | Costliest first. |

## ListTeams

`POST /spin.v1.TeamService/ListTeams`

List teams (optionally filtered by parent)

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `parentId` | string | Optional: filter by parent (empty = root teams only) |
| `includeAllDescendants` | boolean | If true, include all nested teams |
| `page` | [PageRequest](/reference/api/types/#pagerequest) |  |
| `everyTeam` | boolean | every_team lists the whole installation rather than the caller's own teams - the administration view, and only an instance admin may ask for it. It is asked for rather than inferred from who is calling: an admin's own Teams page should be their teams, not a list of everybody's personal team that they cannot get out of. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `teams` | list of [Team](/reference/api/types/#team) |  |
| `page` | [PageResponse](/reference/api/types/#pageresponse) |  |

## SetNetworkPolicy

`POST /spin.v1.TeamService/SetNetworkPolicy`

A team's egress policies: named, and only allowing - no rule brokers - for the workspaces of the team and the teams below it. Set and deleted by its admins where the installation lets teams declare them (team_network_policies); listed by WorkspaceService.ListNetworkPolicies.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `teamId` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `rules` | list of [NetworkRule](/reference/api/types/#networkrule) |  |

**Response**

No fields: `{}`.

## SetSecret

`POST /spin.v1.TeamService/SetSecret`

A team's secrets: what a brokered network rule has the host's egress proxy add to a request, so a workspace of the team uses a key it never holds. Set and deleted by the team's admins, listed by name to its members; a value is never answered with again.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `teamId` | string |  |
| `name` | string | Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter; what a rule names it by. |
| `value` | string | At most 8 KiB of visible ASCII. Replaces what the name held. |
| `hosts` | list of string | The exact names the secret may be sent to, 1 to 16: a brokered rule that injects it and names any other host is refused it. |
| `ref` | string | In place of value: the ARN of a Secrets Manager secret or a Parameter Store parameter the team keeps it in, read as the team (the setting team_secrets_role) now and whenever a host asks for it. |

**Response**

No fields: `{}`.
